params.body:
Second card after Deployed (#263), reading the verdicts abovebeyond-ai/elixir#171 writes for `app`.

- Each line whose facet Elixir judged (`scheduler`, `jobs`, `failing`, `queue`, `backlog`, `debug`, `disk`, `cache`, `errors`, `reachable`) takes Elixir's level; the PHP rule next to it stays as fallback for a row written before Elixir judged, and goes in the follow-up PR once a round has written verdicts everywhere.
- One `Judged` line names the thresholds that fired, worst first ("scheduler silent for minutes (42) · SCHEDULER_LATE"); "by Elixir, every facet ok" when nothing fired; "not yet" on an old row. The card's `facet` is the worst one, as for Deployed.
- New `Failing` line: a job that fails on every run while never late (the 120-runs auto-deploy case) had `failingNames` in the measurement and no line on the card.

Behaviour on current rows is unchanged (no verdicts yet, rules apply). Tests: four new cases in `AppHealthCardTest`. Suite green except the worktree-only `BuildStampTest`; PHPStan and Pint clean.

Merge order: elixir#171 first, then this; the fallback makes either order safe.
params.title: The App health card reads Elixir's verdict per facet
